name: user-management-system
description: User Management System with Angular client and Node.js server

scripts.install: npm run install:client && npm run install:server
scripts.build:client: node init && cd client && npm run build
scripts.start:client: node init && cd client && npm start
scripts.start:server: node init && cd server && npm start
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
